claim: The Service Health Dashboard and the AWS Personal Health Dashboard were rebranded to the AWS Health Dashboard (document history row dated February 28, 2022).
question: What were the Personal Health Dashboard and the Service Health Dashboard renamed to?

values.display: rebranded to the AWS Health Dashboard

note: Older questions and some docs still say Personal Health Dashboard (PHD). Write: AWS Health Dashboard (formerly Personal Health Dashboard). The date is before mid-2022, so no Changed recently note is needed beyond the name.
